purpose: Document city-local land/property registry or map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: The official Hubei Provincial Department of Natural Resources describes Xiangyang’s city real-estate registration center and a city cadastral-map visual inquiry service. Public instructions for the Xiangyang online hall say the inquirer first authenticates and searches by property address, certificate number or unit number. This verifies local registry and map inquiry, but does not establish anonymous parcel-vector access. The documented Xiangyang cadastral-map lookup is accessed through the Hubei government service platform after identity verification and requires a known property locator. No anonymous geometry-only vector endpoint or safe feature schema was found; no login or property lookup was attempted.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official provincial natural-resources retrospective explicitly names Xiangyang’s real-estate registration reforms, city online hall, and cadastral-map visual query service.

Xiangyang Daily report describes the documented citizen workflow as identity verification in Hubei’s government service platform, selection of Xiangyang online registry hall, and lookup by address, certificate or unit number. This secondary report was used only to clarify access conditions.
